name: Priya
trust_unlock: Ask what she cooks, who she hosts, and whether total investment or payment timing is the concern.
same_day_close_condition: Connect kitchen layout to use, distinguish equipment/material/labor warranties, explain approved financing without invented terms.

triggers.line: I want something I will actually use, not just something pretty.
That sounds expensive. How could payments work?
I need to understand what is included before I agree.

scenarios.title: The weekend cook
scenarios.constraint: Payment timing matters more than minimizing every feature.
scenarios.opening: I would love to cook outside more often.

scenarios.title: Dinner for a crowd
scenarios.priority: Prep, grill and serve larger groups without crowding.
scenarios.constraint: Gas and electrical run distances must be measured separately.
scenarios.opening: We entertain a lot and I want this area to function better.

scenarios.title: A practical first kitchen
scenarios.priority: Stop carrying food and tools back and forth indoors.
scenarios.constraint: Needs an honest scope comparison and approved financing information.
scenarios.opening: I am interested in an outdoor kitchen, but I need to watch the investment.
